summary: Implemented FTS5 search in .boreal/cache/index.sqlite with BM25 field weighting, final-token prefix matching, snippets, feature detection, and JSON fallback. Search field extraction is shared between JSON and FTS indexes; object-index rebuilds and incremental writes populate search_fts transactionally. Dogfood sync refresh reports mode=fts with 1311 docs, search-index.json remains absent, and built CLI search for 'workflow ref' completed in 0.90s with snippets.
command: env COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm check && env COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm test && env COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm --silent bwrk sync refresh --json >/tmp/boreal-sync-refresh-t3.json && /usr/bin/time -p node apps/cli/dist/index.js search query 'workflow ref' --json >/tmp/boreal-search-workflow-ref-dist-t3.json && /usr/bin/time -p env COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm --silent bwrk sync status --json >/tmp/boreal-sync-status-final-t3.json && env COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm --silent bwrk doctor --strict --json >/tmp/boreal-doctor-strict-t3.json && git diff --check
